comments.author: @fernandbaeteman4519
comments.text:
For my job, I  visited numerous factories in the Netherlands. Mostly printing companies. I'm retired now, but I still remember their hospitality on arrival. Before going to the job, it always started by having a coffee, while talking about the ongoing problem. No hurry, no pressure . They were always glad that someone came to solve their problem. 
After the repair, it ended like it started. With coffee and talking. Some people became a personal friend, asking my advise on some future project and eventual issues involved in it. 
I must say, I had the same experiences in Germany. In France, I experienced less hospitality. No coffee, only moaning about the ongoing problem. (as if I could help it from happening...)
The positive point in Germany and France, was that I spoke their own language, even in technical terms. 
A 79 old viewer in Belgium, retired at 75 !. (addicted to his job....)

replies.author: @EpicWorldDiscoveries-m2g
